reply_text:
I reviewed `excerpt-helper` against `main` (2 commits) and didn't change anything. The tests pass, but there's one bug I'd fix before merging, plus a few smaller issues.

**Blocking: every excerpt gets an ellipsis, even when nothing was cut.**
`excerpt()` in `src/excerpt.js` always adds `…`. It never checks whether the text already fits within the limit. I ran a few quick checks:
- `excerpt('short', 50)` returns `"short…"`
- `excerpt('', 10)` returns `"…"`

The README says short text should come back unchanged and the ellipsis should only appear when text was removed. As it stands, every short card body would show a stray `…`. The tests miss this because the only excerpt test uses text that's longer than the limit. The fix is to return `trimmed` early when `trimmed.length <= limit`, and add a test for that case.

**Should fix: a word that ends exactly at the limit gets dropped.**
`lastSpaceBefore` only looks at the first `limit` characters (`text.slice(0, limit)`). So when a word ends exactly at the limit, the code doesn't see the space right after it and cuts one word too early. For example, `excerpt('the quick brown', 9)` returns `"the…"` when it should return `"the quick…"`. Looking at `limit + 1` characters would fix it and match the README's "at or before the limit."

**Minor:**
- **Length can go over the limit:** the ellipsis is added after the cut, so an excerpt can be `limit + 1` characters long. That's fine if `limit` means "text before the ellipsis." If the card has a hard width, you'd need to keep 1 character free for it.
- **Long single words:** when the first `limit` characters contain no space, the text is cut mid-word. That's reasonable, just worth knowing.
- **`toPlain` removes underscores from inside words:** `my_var_name` becomes `myvarname`. It also leaves heading and list markers in place: `"# Title\n- item"` becomes `"# Title - item"`. Code-heavy snippets may look a bit off.
- **Unrelated edit:** the CHANGELOG commit also rewords the old 1.4.0 entry ("a title and a body" becomes "a title and body"). It's harmless, but it's an extra change that doesn't belong in this branch.

The version bump to 1.5.0 and the new CHANGELOG entry look fine. Once the ellipsis bug is fixed and has a test, I'd be happy for this to merge.
